case.title: Default and saved settings show as separate groups in the reports
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • About 20 minutes, all on one day.
  • Sign in on the QA branch (sv10043) with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List).
  • Work in one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"). To change it: your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  • No Google Analytics access is needed. You read what the Work Orders page sends to Google Analytics in the browser's own developer tools (Chrome or Edge): press F12, click the Network tab, tick Preserve log, and type collect in the filter box. Each analytics message shows as a request named collect; click it and open its Payload tab. Each event in it lists: en (the event name), ep.element_location (the display: list, tech_view or board_view), ep.element_label (the field or the density), ep.setting_source (default = never changed, saved = chosen earlier) and uid (the user). One request can hold several events, one per line.
  • Turn off any ad blocker or privacy extension for this site, and use a new private window for each user, so the messages are not stopped or mixed up.
  • Events to look for: work_orders_field_load (one per field on the card) and work_orders_density_load. Each shows ep.setting_source: default (never changed) or saved (chosen earlier).

Setup

  1. Settings > Staff: add a brand-new user "ZZAUTOTEST Newbie" at this location with a role that has Work Orders View, and finish the invite so they can sign in. Do not open Work Orders as this user yet. If that name has been used before, add a new user and read the expected results with the new name.
  2. As Admin (the dispatcher): Work Orders > Board View > Density > pick Comfortable. Then sign out.
case.custom_steps:
1. In a new private window open the browser tools as described in the Preconditions (F12 > Network > Preserve log > filter collect).
  2. Sign in as ZZAUTOTEST Newbie, open Work Orders and click Board View. Wait 10 seconds.
  3. Click each collect request and find the work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load events. For each write down ep.element_label, ep.setting_source and uid.
  4. Sign out and close the window. In a new private window open the browser tools the same way, sign in as Admin (your dispatcher), open Work Orders and click Board View. Wait 10 seconds.
  5. Find the work_orders_density_load event and write down ep.element_label, ep.setting_source and uid.
  6. Put your notes into two groups by ep.setting_source: default and saved. Write down which user (uid) falls in which group.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: ZZAUTOTEST Newbie's field and density events show ep.setting_source = default (they never changed them).
  • Step 5: the dispatcher's density event shows ep.element_label = comfortable and ep.setting_source = saved.
  • Step 6: default and saved come out as separate groups, with ZZAUTOTEST Newbie (their uid) under default and the dispatcher's density (the dispatcher's uid) under saved. Each user keeps the same uid on every event.
  • A fallback (a setting that could not be loaded) cannot be caused by hand. Write "fallback: not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • The report page itself is built by the report owner inside Google Analytics, outside ShopView, and is not part of this test (QA lead's ruling below).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names.
  • QA lead's instruction, 12 Oct 2026 17:19 UTC, in the QA session chat, word for word: “DO You really need google analytics for that ? Can you check again. Please do not get me ridiculed. See if you can test this in SHOPVIEW QA branch.” Then his ruling at 17:22 UTC. Question put to him: “How should I record the analytics tests, now that everything ShopView sends checks out on the QA branch?” His answer, word for word: “Pass on QA-branch data (Recommended)”. The steps were changed on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d) to read the events in the browser instead of Google Analytics.
